method: Reverse-DCF bisection: value(g)=Σ_{i=1..10} fcf·(1+g)^i/(1+10%)^i + terminal[fcf·(1+g)^10·(1+2.5%)/(10%-2.5%)]/(1+10%)^10; solved so (value+cash)/shares=price. Excludes pre-revenue/negative-FCF story names (Oklo, NuScale/SMR, IonQ, Rigetti, D-Wave, Quantinuum, CoreWeave, Nebius, AST SpaceMobile, Hertz) and banks/insurers (GS, UNH) where reverse-DCF is not meaningful. ASML and CCJ excluded here due to non-USD (EUR/CAD) reported financials vs USD-quoted ADR price.
